missed_facts.fact: Customer Service receives about 6,000 PO emails per week

invented_claims.claim: API contract tests use pytest or Postman/Newman
Web UI tests use Playwright or Selenium
Load and throughput tests use Azure Load Testing or JMeter
AI evaluation uses Python scripts and stores results in Cosmos DB/dashboards
A correlation ID must be present in logs across all components for each processed email
Processing must support scanned PDFs using OCR
EDI ingestion is excluded from MVP1

references: Explicit list of reference documents (Email Order Entry BRD and architecture diagram) with versions/locations and any supplementary standards or policies
security_compliance: Explicit MFA/session timeout/JWT lifetime test cases and acceptance criteria (session timeout, token expiration)
CSRF and XSS specific test cases for UI
Explicit spoofed-sender detection tests and prompt‑injection resilience test cases called out under security
nfr_reliability: Backup & restore procedures and tests, data reconciliation after recovery and related verification
Runbook validation and alerting/playbook exercises (explicit recovery runbook test cases)
nfr_accessibility_compat: Accessibility test cases: screen reader labels, keyboard-only navigation, focus order, colour contrast, error identification and zoom/reflow
Browser compatibility matrix and tests for enterprise-supported Edge/Chrome/Firefox versions
